lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A geometric grid of high-intensity white circular spots arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and fourteen vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a highly structured checkerboard pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by high-luminance highlights on the dorsal edge and sharp shadow gradients on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density, irregular distribution of small high-luminance spots confined within the perimeter of the first dorsal fin's silhouette, primarily visible on the lower half.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) located ventrally, one posterior to the pectoral fin and one near the mid-ventral flank.
